name: Nasir
pronunciation: nah-SEER, from Nasir al-Mulk Mosque in Shiraz
about: This vivid spectrum comes from the stained glass of Nasir al-Mulk Mosque in Shiraz. Violet and cobalt open into cyan and green, then turn through gold to vermilion. I use it when a map or chart needs bright colors and strong contrast.
notes: deep shadow, the wooden frame and dark interior
cobalt, pointed panes and flower centers
azure, blue glass around the upper fans
jade, green rings in the rose windows
spring green, the lower floral panels
vermilion, red petals and floor reflections

source.title: Stained-glass window at Nasir al-Mulk Mosque
source.context_caption: Sunlight and stained glass reflected across the prayer hall of Nasir al-Mulk Mosque
